description: This file defines the CandidateActionController class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It extends an abstract Vue controller and handles pre-render logic for candidate-related actions, including selecting components and passing relevant properties based on user actions and candidate data.

classes.name: CandidateActionController
classes.description: Controller handling candidate actions in the recruitment process, determines the appropriate UI component based on user selection, fetches candidate data, and manages interview IDs.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component and properties for rendering based on the candidate ID and selected action.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render logic to determine and initialize the appropriate Vue component based on the candidate's action.
